title: A Comparative Study of Multi-Criteria Decision-Making Methods for Selecting Sustainable Energy Projects in Rangamati, Bangladesh
venue: Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Power, Electronics, Communications, Computing, and Intelligent Infrastructure (PECCII)
abstract: A rigorous comparative study benchmarking Multi-Criteria Decision-Making (MCDM) methods for ranking and prioritizing sustainable energy infrastructure initiatives in the Rangamati hill tracts region.
